{"code": "from math import sqrt

# Compute sample sizes
n_treatment = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]
n_control = df[df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]

# Compute response proportions
treatment_resp_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_resp_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_effect = treatment_resp_rate - control_resp_rate

# Pooled proportion
p_pooled = (df['responded'].sum()) / (n_treatment + n_control)

# Standard error of the difference in proportions
se_diff = sqrt(p_pooled * (1 - p_pooled) * (1/n_treatment + 1/n_control))

# 95% confidence interval
z = 1.96
lower_ci = treatment_effect - z * se_diff
upper_ci = treatment_effect + z * se_diff

# Print all required values
print(f"Proportion of response in treatment arm: {treatment_resp_rate}")
print(f"Proportion of response in control arm: {control_resp_rate}")
print(f"Treatment effect (treatment minus control): {treatment_effect}")
print(f"Standard error of the difference: {se_diff}")
print(f"95% confidence interval: [{lower_ci}, {upper_ci}]")"}
